definition: H Company, also known simply as H, is a French artificial intelligence startup which develops "action-oriented" artificial intelligence agents for enterprise automation and productivity.
details: In May 2024, H Company closed a record-setting $220 million seed round, at the time the largest AI raise in Europe. In 2026, H Company released Holo 3, the latest generation of its computer-use AI models. The update marked a major advance in agentic AI, enabling agents to navigate any user interface, interpret screens, and complete complex, multi-step tasks across enterprise systems—much like a human user.

explainer.lead: H Company is a French artificial intelligence startup building agents that carry out work on computers, rather than only generating text or answers. Its technology is aimed at automating multi-step tasks across enterprise software.

tiers.eli5: H Company makes computer helpers that can look at a screen and use software a bit like a person does. Instead of just telling you what to click, its agents are designed to follow the steps and finish the job.
tiers.practitioner: H Company's agents are intended for enterprise automation, with Holo 3 supporting computer-use tasks such as interpreting screens, navigating interfaces and completing multi-step workflows. Practical deployments still require careful task definitions and checks that an agent completed each step correctly, particularly when work spans several systems.
tiers.paperLevel: H Company is an organization developing action-oriented agents: systems that perceive user interfaces and execute sequences of actions toward a task goal. Holo 3, released in 2026, is described as a generation of computer-use models supporting screen interpretation, interface navigation and complex multi-step enterprise tasks; quantitative capabilities and limitations are not specified.
